name: Plush Time
detailed_description:
Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.

ONLINE AND LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

Play your way. Plush Time supports 1 to 6 players, whether you're online or huddled around the same screen. No matter how you play — solo, with friends, or against ruthless plush-brained AI — it’s all the same chaotic, friendship-testing fun.

MINIGAMES

From sugar-fueled scrambles to full-blown food fights, Plush Time serves up a deliciously wild variety of minigames. Fight for cake dominance in Sugar Rush, shove your way through a crowded restaurant in Tippy Waiters, hurl unwanted toppings in No More Olives, and build the tallest dessert disaster in Sundae Stackoff. Cute on the outside — pure competitive chaos on the inside.

BOARD MODE

There’s only room for one winner, and let’s be honest — it better be you. Race across unpredictable boards, collect absurd items, and use every dirty trick in the book to outplay, outwit, and out-chaos your plushy rivals on the road to victory.

SOCIAL HUB

The calm before the chaos. In the Social Hub, you can chill out, chat with other players, customize your plush, talk to quirky NPCs, or even watch YouTube videos together in the cinema room — all while waiting for that one friend who takes forever to join the game. It’s the perfect place to vibe before the chaos kicks in.

BOTS

No friends? No problem. Plush Time’s got fully functional bots with adjustable difficulty — from harmless fluff to full-blown plush assassins. Whether you're practicing solo or just pretending your friends showed up, the AI is always ready to rumble (and probably cheat a little).

DEVELOPED BY A SINGLE PERSON

Built by one very tired human. Plush Time was created entirely by a solo developer — every feature, every detail, every bug lovingly handcrafted. If something breaks, just remember: it was probably held together with coffee and determination.
